Here's the FigDown document for this topology. A couple of authoring notes first:

- I did not have `reference/experimental/topology.md` loaded (only the genre-independent core doc was provided), so I've used the most conservative, generic constructs shown in the core spec (`node`, `link`, `class`) rather than any topology-specific keyword I can't verify. Run `node build-svg.js branch-wan-uplinks.fd` and fix any line errors it reports against the real topology grammar before treating this as final.
- The description distinguishes a **primary** vs **backup** WAN link — that's a meaningful fact, so I encoded it as a `class` (with its own stated meaning) rather than baking it into a label or leaving it as bare color, per "class is how meaning survives."
- `topology` is EXPERIMENTAL (experimental) but dispatchable at `figdown 0.1`, so no version bump is needed — flagged here per the portability rule.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 topology
title "Branch office WAN uplinks"

class primary "Primary WAN uplink"
class backup "Backup WAN uplink" style=dashed

node access1 "Access Switch 1"
node access2 "Access Switch 2"
node branch "Branch Router"
node hubprimary "Primary Regional Hub"
node hubbackup "Backup Regional Hub"

link access1 branch
link access2 branch
link branch hubprimary class=primary
link branch hubbackup class=backup
```

Embed it as:

```markdown
![Branch office WAN uplinks](figures/branch-wan-uplinks.svg)

<sub>source: [figures/branch-wan-uplinks.fd](figures/branch-wan-uplinks.fd)</sub>
```
